name: Yirla
description:
Yirla connects Claude to your competitor's intelligence and ad campaign data across LinkedIn, Google, YouTube, Meta, Reddit, TikTok, and OpenAI ad platforms.
Ask Claude to:
- Search for and add competitors to your watchlist
- Pull a competitor's full ad intelligence report — ad counts and formats per platform, plus AI-generated persona, messaging, and offer insights
- Compare 2–5 competitors side-by-side across persona, messaging, offers, creative formats, and white-space opportunities
- Scan your watchlist for this week's new and updated ad activity
- List campaigns across all your connected ad accounts
- Analyze a specific campaign's funnel, top/bottom creatives, spend efficiency, and AI recommendations
- Switch between Yirla workspaces mid-conversation, no reconnect required
Requires a Yirla account with at least one connected ad platform and, for competitor tools, an active watchlist. Connects via OAuth — your Yirla login, no separate API key needed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Yirla to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Yirla to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.yirla.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Yirla MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yirla provides these MCP tools: add_to_watchlist, analyze_campaign, analyze_competitor, compare_competitors, get_connected_accounts, get_watchlist, get_weekly_signals, list_campaigns, list_workspaces, search_competitors, and switch_workspace.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Yirla?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Yirla in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Yirla requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Yirla is developed by Yirla. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
